audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer rows 3 and 5 read 'Skill' and row 6 read 'Ryze', while the content layer and the packet chart both read Zed on all seven rows.
audit.why: Ryze is immobile with no combat escape — Realm Warp is a delayed portal, not a dash — so Zed leads every stage; the full layer's own phases[6].why already says 'Late Zed picks', which contradicted the 'Ryze' side sitting above it.
audit.corrected: phases[3], [5] and [6] sides moved to Zed as one group. The whys on all three already describe Zed winning, so none needed rewriting.

audit.why: Zed spikes at 6 and first-item lethality; Ryze's spike is two to three items of stacked mana through Arcane Mastery, which arrives after Zed's window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Rune Prison a 'point-blank root' with no condition and no cooldown. It only roots a target that already has Flux on it — otherwise it is a slow.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' That conditional is the whole defensive read in this lane and it was missing.
audit.corrected: The Flux condition, Rune Prison's 11-9s cooldown and Overload's 5s reset written into breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Bodies did not match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: QA pass: matchup-lint and regression-check still reported findings on this matchup after the proposing pass.
audit.why: Edits from the earlier pass were rejected by apply-proposals (length drift, or a phrase matching the non-interaction filter), so the defects survived on disk.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Living Shadow (swap) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rune Prison is 11s down to 9s at 615 range — the point-blank root starts every kill combo, so step up only on its cooldown. - Overload is a flat 5s from 1000 and Spell Flux 3.5s to 2.5s. - Realm Warp is 180/160/140 and reaches 3000.

edits.after: W wide, E the slow, Q the scissor from two angles — at 900 range you sit outside his 615 Rune Prison.
